The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. Standalone software licensing is not established. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
